福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

妙壽宮與金萬安王船Miaoshou Temple & the Jin Wan'an King Boat

台灣的廟門口大多立著龍柱，但古堡旁的這座小廟，迎接你的卻是蝙蝠！明朝末年，一艘載著神像的王船停在海邊，當地漁民把神像迎回奉祀。乾隆年間正式建廟，主祀醫藥之神保生大帝。看看石柱：五隻蝙蝠在祥雲間飛舞，就是「五福臨門」！兩隻仙鶴口銜靈芝，象徵長壽。這是全台唯一的蝙蝠石柱。這對柱子是「二手」的！來自清代福建班兵建的媽祖廟海山館。門神也有故事：玄天上帝向保生大帝借寶劍，用三十六官將當抵押，結果寶劍一直沒還！另一組門神畫的是二十四節氣：小暑拿著一小簇火，大暑端著一整盆火。對面停著金萬安王船，是安平廟宇供奉的王船中最大的一艘。在安平，王船是供奉用的，不放流，也不焚燒。

Most Taiwanese temples greet you with dragon pillars. This little temple beside the old fort greets you with bats! At the end of the Ming dynasty, a boat carrying divine statues anchored offshore, and local fishermen brought the statues home to worship. In the Qianlong era, a proper temple was built. Its main deity is Baosheng Dadi, the God of Medicine. Look at the stone pillars: five bats flutter among auspicious clouds. Five fortunes are arriving at your door! Two cranes hold lingzhi mushrooms in their beaks, meaning long life. These are the only bat pillars in all of Taiwan. The pillars are second-hand! They came from Haishan Hall, a Mazu shrine built by Qing garrison soldiers from Fujian. The door gods tell a story. The Dark Emperor borrowed a sword from Baosheng Dadi and left the Thirty-Six Officials as collateral. The sword was never returned! Other doors show the twenty-four solar terms: Minor Heat with a little flame, Major Heat with a whole basin of fire. Across the street rests the Jin Wan'an King Boat. It is the largest King Boat in any Anping temple. In Anping, King Boats are worshipped. They are never set afloat and never burned.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

妙壽宮就在安平古堡旁，廟門口立的不是龍柱，而是全台唯一以蝙蝠為主題的石柱；對面還供奉著安平廟宇中最大的王船「金萬安號」。小小一座廟，藏著安平人的信仰與工藝。

Miaoshou Temple stands beside Fort Zeelandia. Instead of dragon columns, its doorway has the only bat-themed stone columns in Taiwan, and across the way sits the Jin Wan'an, the largest king boat kept by any temple in Anping.

  1. 明末 Late Ming（相傳 legend）一艘載著神像的王船停在海邊，漁民把神像迎回奉祀。A king boat carrying god statues drifts ashore, and fishermen take the statues in.
  2. 乾隆年間 Qianlong era正式建廟，主祀醫藥之神保生大帝。The temple is formally built for Baosheng Dadi, the god of medicine.
  3. 1867閩南造船名匠重造金萬安號王船，約十公尺長。Master boatbuilders rebuild the Jin Wan'an king boat, about ten meters long.
  4. 今天 Today廟柱原屬清代班兵所建的海山館；王船只供奉，不放流也不焚燒。Its columns came from the Haishan Hostel; the king boat is honored, never set adrift or burned.

認識景點

About the place

保生大帝：妙壽宮主祀的神明，醫藥之神。 蝙蝠石柱：全台唯一以蝙蝠為主題的廟柱。 五福臨門：五隻蝙蝠在祥雲間，代表五福臨門。 仙鶴銜靈芝：仙鶴口銜靈芝，象徵長壽。

Baosheng Dadi, God of Medicine: The main deity of Miaoshou Temple. bat pillar: The only bat-themed temple pillars in Taiwan. five fortunes: Five bats among clouds mean five fortunes arriving at your door. crane with lingzhi: A crane with a lingzhi mushroom in its beak means longevity.

對聯：刻在柱上的兩行對句，落款王得祿。 門神：畫在廟門上的守護神。 三十六官將：他們被當作借劍的抵押，從此留在保生大帝身邊。 抵押品：借東西時留下的擔保，表示一定會歸還。

couplet: Two matching lines carved on the pillars, signed by Wang De-lu. door gods: Guardian gods painted on temple doors. the Thirty-Six Officials: They were left as collateral for a borrowed sword, and stayed forever. collateral: Something you leave behind when you borrow, to show you will return it.

二十四節氣：漢人古老的太陽曆，農民依節氣耕作。 大約每十五天一個節氣：把太陽一年在天上走的路線平分成二十四等份，所以大約每十五天就有一個節氣。 春季六節氣：立春、雨水、驚蟄、春分、清明、穀雨。 夏季六節氣：立夏、小滿、芒種、夏至、小暑、大暑。

the Twenty-Four Solar Terms: The ancient Han solar calendar that guided farmers. every fifteen days: The sun's yearly path is split into twenty-four equal parts, so a new solar term comes about every fifteen days. spring solar terms: Beginning of Spring, Rain Water, Awakening of Insects, Spring Equinox, Pure Brightness, Grain Rain. summer solar terms: Beginning of Summer, Grain Buds, Grain in Ear, Summer Solstice, Minor Heat, Major Heat.

秋季六節氣：立秋、處暑、白露、秋分、寒露、霜降。 冬季六節氣：立冬、小雪、大雪、冬至、小寒、大寒。 雷震子（驚蟄）：春天門板上，驚蟄正是春雷響起的時候，所以畫成背上有翅膀的雷震子。 海龍王（雨水）：雨水是會呼風喚雨的海龍王。

autumn solar terms: Beginning of Autumn, End of Heat, White Dew, Autumn Equinox, Cold Dew, Frost's Descent. winter solar terms: Beginning of Winter, Minor Snow, Major Snow, Winter Solstice, Minor Cold, Major Cold. Thunder Child: On the spring door, Awakening of Insects falls when the first spring thunder rolls, so he is drawn as the winged Thunder Child. Dragon King: Rain Water appears as the Dragon King of the Sea, who commands wind and rain.

王船：神聖的船；在安平王船是供奉的，不放流也不焚燒。 船身、船殼：船的主體，看看上面畫的眼睛。 船眼：眼睛朝前是戰船，朝下是漁船，朝上是貨船。 手工雕刻：甲板上的小船員、船錨和纜繩，全是手工雕出來的。

King Boat: A sacred boat. In Anping, King Boats are worshipped, never set afloat or burned. hull: The main body of a ship. Look for the eyes painted on it. ship's eyes: Eyes forward mean a warship, down a fishing boat, up a cargo ship. hand-carved: The miniature crew, anchors and rigging are all hand-carved.

約十公尺長：1867 年（清同治六年），閩南造船名匠重造金萬安號，把它放大到約十公尺長；它是安平廟宇供奉的王船中最大的一艘。

about ten meters long: In 1867, master shipwrights from southern Fujian rebuilt the Jin Wan'an and made it about this long. It is the largest King Boat enshrined in any Anping temple.

實景照片

Photos on site

三川殿 The front hall

妙壽宮的三川殿：門上掛著「妙壽宮」匾額和刺繡八仙彩。廟在清乾隆二十年（1755年）建成，主祀保生大帝，現在是直轄市定古蹟。門前這對花崗石柱，就是有名的蝙蝠石柱。

This is the front hall of Miaoshou Temple. It was built in seventeen fifty-five, and its main god is Baosheng Dadi. The two granite pillars at the door are the famous bat pillars.

石柱上的蝙蝠 A bat on the pillar

近看石柱：一隻張開翅膀的蝙蝠刻在石頭上，下面還有一隻。「蝠」和「福」同音，所以蝙蝠代表福氣。

Look closely at the pillar. A bat spreads its wings in the stone, and there is another one below it. In Chinese, bat sounds like fortune, so bats bring good luck.

王得祿題字 Wang De-lu's name

石柱上刻著「威靈赫濯，軍民盡感慈庥」，旁邊小字「信官王得祿敬撰」。王得祿是嘉義出身的清代名將。這對石柱刻於道光十六年（1836年），原本在海山館，後來才移到妙壽宮。

This pillar's couplet is signed in small characters by Wang De-lu, a famous Qing general from Chiayi. The pillars were carved in eighteen thirty-six for Haishan Hall, and later moved here.

三十六官將 The Thirty-Six Officials

側門門板上畫著三十六官將。每位官將騎著馬或神獸，旁邊寫著名字，例如康元帥、高元帥、岳元帥。為什麼門神是三十六官將？廟的門神常跟主神有關。妙壽宮主祀保生大帝，民間傳說三十六官將原本是玄天上帝的部將：玄天上帝為了除妖，向保生大帝借寶劍，用三十六官將當抵押，後來寶劍沒有歸還，三十六官將就留在保生大帝身邊，成為左右護法。臺南同樣主祀保生大帝的興濟宮、良皇宮，門神也畫三十六官將。

The side doors show the Thirty-Six Officials. Each one rides a horse or a magical animal, and his name is written beside him. Why are the door gods the Thirty-Six Officials? A temple's door gods often match its main god, and this temple honors Baosheng Dadi. A folk story says the officials first served the Dark Emperor. He borrowed Baosheng Dadi's sword to fight demons and left the officials as a pledge. The sword was never returned, so they stayed to guard Baosheng Dadi. In Tainan, Xingji Temple and Lianghuang Temple also honor Baosheng Dadi, and their door gods are the Thirty-Six Officials too.

三十六官將（另一扇門） More Officials

另一扇側門上也畫著三十六官將：楊元帥、王元帥、鄧元帥、紀仙姑、李仙姑……有的騎馬，有的騎鳥、大象或神獸。

The other side door shows more of the Thirty-Six Officials. Some ride horses, and others ride birds, an elephant or magical beasts.

春季節氣神 Spring solar terms

這扇門板畫著春天的六個節氣神，每位旁邊的雲上寫著名字：立春（最上面，字已模糊）、雨水、驚蟄、春分、清明、穀雨。雨水是會呼風喚雨的海龍王；驚蟄正是春雷響起的時候，所以畫成背上有翅膀的雷震子。

This door shows the six spring solar terms. Each god stands on a cloud with a name label. Rain Water appears as the Dragon King of the sea, who commands wind and rain. Awakening of Insects falls when the first spring thunder rolls, so he is drawn as the winged Thunder Child.

夏季節氣神 Summer solar terms

夏天的門板有些字已經褪色，還看得出「芒種」「小暑」「大暑」。小暑手裡只有一小簇火，到了大暑就變成滿滿一盆火：天氣一步一步熱起來。

On the summer door, some labels have faded, but you can still read Grain in Ear, Minor Heat and Major Heat. Minor Heat carries just a small flame, but by Major Heat it has grown into a whole basin of fire. Step by step, the weather heats up.

秋季節氣神 Autumn solar terms

秋天的門板：處暑、白露、秋分、寒露、霜降。最上面那位的名字已經褪色，依照順序，他就是立秋。

The autumn door shows End of Heat, White Dew, Autumn Equinox, Cold Dew and Frost's Descent. The top label has faded, but by the order, he is Beginning of Autumn.

冬季節氣神 Winter solar terms

冬天的門板：立冬、小雪、大雪、冬至、小寒、大寒。猜猜看：「大寒」手上拿的是什麼？到最下面找找看！

The winter door shows Beginning of Winter, Minor Snow, Major Snow, Winter Solstice, Minor Cold and Major Cold. What is Major Cold holding? Look at the bottom!

金萬安王船 The Jin Wan'an King Boat

金萬安號王船在清同治六年（1867年）由閩南造船名匠重造，現在供奉在自己的王船室裡。船邊的牌子寫著「請勿登船」。

This is the Jin Wan'an King Boat. It was rebuilt in eighteen sixty-seven by master shipwrights from southern Fujian, and today it rests indoors in its own boat room. The sign says: please do not board the boat.

王船的船眼 The boat's eye

綠色的船頭畫著一隻大大的船眼，上方有一隻彩色鳳凰。旁邊的紅旗寫著「朱府千歲」，朱府千歲是妙壽宮最早的主神。

A big round eye is painted on the green bow, under a colorful phoenix. The red flag names Lord Zhu, the first main god of this temple.
